content:
Adds a logo to the Tenable MSSP Portal. After you add a logo to the Tenable MSSP Portal, use the
PUT /mssp/accounts/logos endpoint to assign the logo to a customer account.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
multipart/form-data
required
string <binary>
The logo to upload. The logo must be in PNG format and no larger than
246x52 pixels.
string
An identifiable, user-defined name for the logo.
logo
required
name
required
Content type
